prompt: A program manager needs to share project insights with people who are not repository collaborators. What is possible?
explanation: Project insights are shareable: expose the charts to a wider audience while editing stays with project members. The data follows the project, not the repository permission list.

options.text: Insights can be shared so viewers can see the charts without project edit rights
Nothing — insights are private to project administrators forever
Insights must be screenshotted and emailed
Sharing requires transferring the project to an organization
